FDA notice: On October 8, 2026 FDA approved atezolizumab (Tecentriq, Genentech) with a fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin for adjuvant treatment of adult and pediatric patients 2 years and older with Stage III dMMR colon cancer.
Adult and pediatric patients 2 years and older (IV Tecentriq). Only 1 pediatric patient in trial.
Tecentriq Hybreza (atezolizumab and hyaluronidase-tqjs) with fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin for patients 12 years and older weighing 40 kg or more.
Adjuvant = after surgery to reduce recurrence risk; standard definition.
ATOMIC/ML39057 (NCT02912559): multicenter, randomized, open-label, active-controlled, Stage III dMMR colon cancer after complete primary tumor resection.

notes: All matched. Caveat: 'children aged two years and older' rests on labelling; the trial enrolled 711 adults and only one pediatric patient. Consider adding that nuance. Hybreza detail came from search summary of FDA notice, not a separate label page.
